title: Connector/ODBC: MADB_Stmt::ArrayOffset is not reset when an exception unwinds out of MADB_StmtExecute, so the next paramset reads out of bounds
vulnerabilityInformation: A vulnerability was identified in the Connector/ODBC library where an exception during parameter-array execute operations left the ArrayOffset variable in a stale state. When a server-reported error interrupted a parameter array, the ArrayOffset was not reset, causing the next paramset operation on the same statement handle to read from an incorrect memory location. This resulted in out-of-bounds reads that could either cause process crashes or silently drop rows from batches. The issue affected both scenarios where the application had or had not set the SQL_ATTR_PARAM_OPERATION_PTR attribute.
